verdict.rationale: Paxos documents a first-party off-ramp: an orchestration converts stablecoins to USD and withdraws to a bank in one call, and its Fiat Transfers API supports withdrawals over Fedwire, SWIFT and CUBIX, including international SWIFT fiat accounts. Every documented payout is in USD, though, so recipients cannot land in their own local fiat, and no published currency or country coverage list appears. missing for 10: off-ramp into non-USD local currencies, a published list of supported currencies and countries, local payment rails beyond wire/CUBIX, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops lead, recipients can land in local fiat — documented off-ramp rails that convert stablecoins into bank transfers across a published set of currencies and countries

citations.quote: Convert stablecoins to USD and withdraw to your bank in one call.
The Fiat Transfers API allows clients to deposit and withdraw fiat via Wire (Fedwire and SWIFT) and CUBIX networks.
For international (SWIFT) wires, set ... routing_number_type to SWIFT.
Automatically convert the stablecoin to fiat, or opt to hold balances in stablecoin.
